title: Platform: Status
summary: The Platform → Status page (Deployment and Operations in one, ST-09): a check · result · next action table first (Worker deployment, storage bindings, recent automation), then health by area, queues with dead letters, scheduled jobs, storage and schema, and deploys. Here one problem: 12 webhook deliveries failed, with Retry 12 beside it and the destructive purge apart in the row's menu.
compare: The page leads with one table, Check · Result · Next action (admin-4-13, study 383); a healthy check's next action reads 'None'; a problem's result says what happened in words with the warning glyph.
Retry and a destructive repair are separate controls: Retry 12 is a visible outline button; Purge dead letters lives in the row's menu with its consequence said in the card foot.
Health by area: each row carries its feature's service (B17); status is the status word and glyph (OK in success, Webhooks behind in warning), never the accent.
Platform-only: Platform context, the Pinned K chip, 'Platform' crumb; no product page shows this.

Refreshing can pause (icon button with its label); 'Checked 40 s ago' is the one freshness line. States: healthy (no problem rows), degraded with one retry (drawn), a failed check (danger), a stale heartbeat (warning with when it last ran), refreshing paused.
Logs are redacted, said once at the foot.
Round 2 (UX review): The webhook failure is said once (Checks) with Retry 12; Health by area says 'Behind'; the queue row states its fact; no sentence narrates where Purge lives.
B17: health rows and the Store uploads queue carry their feature's service; checks, jobs, storage and deploys are core.
